text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Information Minister Muasher says 145 detainees to be put on trial for alleged involvement in recent troubles that broke out after bread prices doubled.
- Cabinet decides to raise financial incentives to doctors by 60 percent.
- Prime Minister Kabariti and Turkish Foreign Minister Ciller exchange views during telephone call over latest developments in Iraq and agreement to intensify coordination on all levels.
- Trial of defendant in Sri Lankan baby sale case resumes and court hears two Sri Lankan witnesses.
- King Hussein and Crown Prince Hassan receive Bahraini trade minister and both sides urge increased economic ties.
- Iraqi press attache in Amman embassy leaves for Baghdad.
